name: @caesarloo/dsh-subagent-queue
description: Queue-based concurrency gate for DSH subagent delegation: a host-layer tools/execute plugin that admits subagent/fork/workflow calls through a FIFO queue instead of failing at the hard child limit, tracks subagent/start|end lifecycle to release slots, serializes workflow runs, refuses nested delegation without waiting (deadlock guard), and reports stuck-slot drift.

scripts.test: node test/scheduler.test.mjs && node test/plugin.test.mjs && node test/host-order.test.mjs && node test/load-smoke.mjs
